stories.line: THE MEN WATCHED THE THANKSGIVING GAME WITH THEIR EYES CLOSED.
stories.caption: Every year the game was on, and every year Dad and Uncle Ray missed the whole second half.
stories.alt_text: Painted illustration of a 1960s wood-paneled living room on Thanksgiving afternoon. A man in a white shirt and loosened tie is asleep in a plaid armchair with his stocking feet on a footstool, and another man in a tan cardigan is asleep on a floral sofa. A console television between them shows a black-and-white football game, and a golden dog sleeps on a braided rug. Text reads: The men watched the Thanksgiving game with their eyes closed.

stories.line: THE BEST THANKSGIVING MEAL WAS THE TURKEY SANDWICH THAT NIGHT.
stories.caption: White bread, cold turkey, a little mayo, and a glass of milk at the kitchen table after everybody went home.
stories.alt_text: Painted illustration of a 1960s kitchen at night. A smiling father in a white undershirt lays turkey slices on bread while a grinning boy in striped pajamas bites into a turkey sandwich. The table holds the leftover turkey, a jar of mayonnaise, cranberry sauce, stuffing and a glass of milk, with turquoise cabinets and a rounded white refrigerator behind them. Text reads: The best Thanksgiving meal was the turkey sandwich that night.
